permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write

concurrency:
  group: gpw-daily-pick-pl
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    env:
      PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/scripts
      GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
      STOOQ_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.STOOQ_API_KEY }}
      GEMINI_GENERATION_MODEL: gemini-3.5-flash-lite
      GEMINI_REVIEW_MODEL: gemini-3.5-flash-lite
      GEMINI_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS: "8"

    steps:
      - name: Check out main
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install requests

      - name: Resolve control-loop mode
        id: run
        shell: bash
        env:
          REQUESTED_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
          EVENT_SCHEDULE: ${{ github.event.schedule }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MODE="auto"
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
            MODE="${REQUESTED_MODE:-auto}"
          elif [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "schedule" ]]; then
            case "$EVENT_SCHEDULE" in
              "40 16 * * 1-5"|"40 17 * * 1-5") MODE="settle" ;;
              *) MODE="auto" ;;
            esac
          fi
          echo "mode=$MODE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "GPW event control mode=$MODE Warsaw=$(TZ=Europe/Warsaw date +%H:%M) schedule=${EVENT_SCHEDULE:-push}"

      - name: Test GPW v2 control, providers, reports and learning contracts
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m unittest \
            tests.test_gpw_daily_pick \
            tests.test_gpw_daily_control_loop \
            tests.test_gpw_event_layer \
            tests.test_gpw_market_data \
            tests.test_gpw_pipeline_v2 \
            tests.test_gpw_daily_pick_ui -v
          python -m py_compile \
            scripts/gpw_daily_pick.py \
            scripts/gpw_daily_control_loop.py \
            scripts/gpw_event_layer.py \
            scripts/gpw_event_driven_loop.py \
            scripts/gpw_market_data.py \
            scripts/gpw_pipeline_v2.py \
            scripts/gpw_provider_v2.py \
            scripts/gpw_reviewer_v2.py
          python -m json.tool data/investments/gpw_daily_pick_config.json >/dev/null
          python -m json.tool data/investments/gpw_daily_pick.json >/dev/null
          node --check scripts/gpw-daily-pick-public.js

      - name: Audit live GPW market coverage before generation
        if: steps.run.outputs.mode == 'auto'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from scripts import gpw_event_driven_loop as runtime
          runtime.install()
          cfg = runtime.gpw.load_config()
          cache = runtime.provider.prefetch_market(cfg)
          audit = runtime.provider.LAST_AUDIT
          print(json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
          minimum = int(len(cfg['universe']) * float(cfg['minimum_data_completeness']) + 0.9999)
          if len(cache) < minimum:
              raise SystemExit(f"GPW market coverage below minimum: received={len(cache)} minimum={minimum}")
          PY

      - name: Check Gemini endpoint without blocking fail-closed state
        if: steps.run.outputs.mode == 'auto'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          python scripts/check_ai_provider.py
          STATUS=$?
          set -e
          if [[ "$STATUS" != "0" ]]; then
            echo "Gemini preflight failed; runtime will preserve fail-closed behavior."
          fi

      - name: Run event-driven self-healing PL GPW loop
        shell: bash
        env:
          MODE: ${{ steps.run.outputs.mode }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python scripts/gpw_event_driven_loop.py --mode "$MODE"
          if [[ "$MODE" == "auto" ]]; then
            python - <<'PY'
          import json
          import subprocess
          from datetime import datetime
          from pathlib import Path
          from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
          today = datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Europe/Warsaw')).date().isoformat()
          payload = json.loads(Path('data/investments/gpw_daily_pick.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          if payload.get('date') == today:
              subprocess.run(['python', 'scripts/gpw_event_driven_loop.py', '--mode', 'validate'], check=True)
          else:
              raise SystemExit(f"GPW runtime did not publish current Warsaw date: {payload.get('date')} != {today}")
          if today == '2026-08-19' and payload.get('decision') != 'TRANSAKCJA':
              raise SystemExit(f"2026-08-19 recovery requires full TRANSAKCJA, got {payload.get('decision')}: {payload.get('reason')}")
          PY
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust the Polish GPW widget
        if: steps.run.outputs.mode == 'auto'
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path('pl/inwestycje/portfel-10k.html')
          text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          updated = text.replace('/scripts/gpw-daily-pick-public.js?v=2','/scripts/gpw-daily-pick-public.js?v=3')
          if updated != text:
              path.write_text(updated, encoding='utf-8')
              print('Bumped GPW client asset to v3.')
          else:
              print('GPW client cache version already current.')
          PY

      - name: Commit scoped GPW state
        id: commit
        if: steps.run.outputs.mode != 'validate'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data/investments/gpw_daily_pick.json data/investments/gpw_daily_pick_metrics.json data/investments/gpw_daily_pick_learning.json 2>/dev/null || true
          git add data/investments/gpw_daily_pick_history 2>/dev/null || true
          git add data/internal/gpw_daily_pick_audit 2>/dev/null || true
          git add pl/inwestycje/portfel-10k.html 2>/dev/null || true
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "No GPW publication change."
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "Publish PL GPW event-driven control state"
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            git pull --rebase origin main
            if git push origin HEAD:main; then
              echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep $((attempt * 4))
          done
          exit 1

      - name: Request fresh Pages build
        if: steps.commit.outputs.changed == 'true'
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for attempt in $(seq 1 18); do
            CODE="$(curl --silent --show-error --output /tmp/gpw-pages.json --write-out '%{http_code}' -X POST -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN}" -H 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pages/builds")"
            if [[ "$CODE" == "201" ]]; then exit 0; fi
            if [[ "$CODE" != "409" ]]; then cat /tmp/gpw-pages.json; exit 1; fi
            sleep 10
          done
          exit 1

      - name: Verify today's PL GPW state on briefrooms.com
        if: steps.commit.outputs.changed == 'true' && steps.run.outputs.mode == 'auto'
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json,time,urllib.request
          from datetime import datetime
          from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
          today=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Europe/Warsaw')).date().isoformat()
          headers={'User-Agent':'BriefRooms-GPW-production-verifier/5.0','Cache-Control':'no-cache'}
          last=None
          for attempt in range(1,49):
              token=f'{int(time.time())}-{attempt}'
              try:
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(f'https://briefrooms.com/data/investments/gpw_daily_pick.json?v={token}',headers=headers),timeout=20) as response:
                      payload=json.load(response)
                  last=payload
                  expected={'TRANSAKCJA'} if today=='2026-08-19' else {'TRANSAKCJA','BRAK_TRANSAKCJI','AWARIA_DANYCH'}
                  if payload.get('date')==today and payload.get('decision') in expected:
                      if payload.get('decision')=='TRANSAKCJA':
                          selection=payload.get('selection') or {}
                          assert selection.get('symbol') and selection.get('market_snapshot',{}).get('date')==today
                      with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(f'https://briefrooms.com/pl/inwestycje/portfel-10k.html?v={token}',headers=headers),timeout=20) as response:
                          html=response.read().decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
                      assert 'gpw-daily-pick-public.js' in html
                      print(f"Production verified: {payload['decision']} {today} {(payload.get('selection') or {}).get('symbol','')}")
                      raise SystemExit(0)
              except Exception as error:
                  print(f"Attempt {attempt}: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:180]}")
              time.sleep(10)
          raise SystemExit(f"Production did not expose expected GPW state: {last}")
          PY

      - name: Enforce scheduled post-open SLA
        if: always() && github.event_name == 'schedule' && steps.run.outputs.mode == 'auto'
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from datetime import datetime,time as clock_time
          from pathlib import Path
          from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
          now=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Europe/Warsaw'))
          if now.time()<clock_time(9,10):
              raise SystemExit(0)
          payload=json.loads(Path('data/investments/gpw_daily_pick.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          quality=payload.get('data_quality') or {}
          attempts=int(quality.get('control_loop_attempts') or 0)
          failed_stage=str(quality.get('failed_stage') or '')
          operational_failure=payload.get('decision')=='AWARIA_DANYCH' and (attempts==0 or failed_stage in {'missed_cutoff_guardian','cutoff_after_retries','cutoff_after_review','opening_quote'})
          if operational_failure:
              raise SystemExit(f"GPW post-open SLA missed: stage={failed_stage or 'unknown'} attempts={attempts}")
          print(f"GPW post-open SLA healthy: decision={payload.get('decision')} attempts={attempts} generated_at={payload.get('generated_at')}")
          PY
'
